# Evenkeel

> Practical, sourced everyday-preparedness guides for households worldwide. Prepared, not scared.

## Guides

- [How to build a home emergency food and water stock](https://beprepareddontfear.github.io/guides/home-emergency-food-and-water-stock.html): water and food quantities, pantry shelf life, storage rules and a homemade kit checklist.
